sections.Description:
The Beatles pinball machine will immerse players in 1960’s Beatlemania and feature nine timeless hit songs from that era.

The game also features iconic introductions by Ed Sullivan along with custom speech and callouts by Hall of Fame disc jockey, Cousin Brucie. Cousin Brucie introduced The Beatles at New York’s Shea Stadium in 1965.
sections.Gameplay Features:
- Throwback playfield and features: The retro-themed playfield features four flippers, eleven drop targets, eight stand-up targets, multiple skill shots, two opto-spinners, and a ball-catching magnet at the top.
- Watch the Record Spin: Watch as the Spinning Record Disc in the center of the playfield begins to spin and uses the magnet to grab and divert balls onto the playfield.
- Experience Beatllemania: All models feature unique art packages, custom powder-coated armor and will immerse players in 1960’s Beatlemania featuring nine timeless hit songs from the era.
